test_case.test_name: Standard-RAS ADDDC device sparing without plus1
test_case.purpose: Validate standard ADDDC device sparing without plus1 on the approved 64GB x4 population, proving harasser PASSED, exact corrected-slot attribution, continued service and no fault lights.
required_package: Approved Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and fully resolved Standard-RAS/no-plus1 harasser recipe
test_case.test_command: After qualified x4 DIMM installation and trained-topology verification, an Intel FAE enables the approved ADDDC/debug settings and invokes `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(...)` once per signed target using the exact vendor-approved Standard-RAS without-plus1 values while retaining `adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False`. Preserve the complete transcript, correlate correctable slot evidence and both physical off states, verify health, then restore hardware/BIOS baseline.
test_case.expected_result: Every signed target completes the exact no-plus1 recipe with `sparing_harasser PASSED`; records attribute a correctable event to the mapped slot; service remains within signed health limits; front-panel and DIMM lightpath remain off; applicable UEFI agrees; configuration is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified 64GB x4 population, exact signed no-plus1 parameters, complete target coverage, untruncated PASSED transcript, correct slot/severity, normal-health limits, no-light evidence and restoration. Guessed values, a different ADDDC variant, generic CE text, self-check skip, wrong target, lamp assertion or instability is not PASS.
safety_gate: Powered-down ESD-controlled DIMM work and qualified operator/FAE are mandatory.
Verify PN/device width/population, trained topology and every resolved parameter before running.
Stop on self-check failure, topology mismatch, unexpected UCE, lamp assertion, crash or health degradation.
No automatic retry or next target before complete evidence and restored health.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash and DIMM PN/width/slot installation proof
Package hash and full resolved Standard/no-plus1 recipe
Trained topology and target coverage matrix
Full Cscript transcript with sparing_harasser PASSED
Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI slot evidence plus both off indicators and health
test_case.recovery: On setup or harasser anomaly, preserve evidence and stop. Qualified operators restore the approved DIMM population and BIOS/RAS settings under ESD/power controls and verify memory health before any separately authorized rerun.
